//: Deno settings for the edge functions (supabase/functions).
//nodeModulesDir: 'none' keeps Deno out of ./node_modules, and that matters more than it looks.
Running `deno check --node-modules-dir=auto` on a function made Deno lay out its
OWN tree there: a second React beside npm's, and node_modules/.bin/next pointed
into node_modules/.deno. The Next build then ran Deno's Next against npm's React
and died prerendering the error pages with 'Cannot read properties of null
(reading useContext)' — a failure with no visible connection to its cause, which
cost an hour to trace. With this set, Deno resolves npm specifiers in its own
global cache and the two toolchains stop sharing a directory.
Recovery, if it happens again: rm -rf node_modules && npm install.
